iterations.summary: Initial full capture; coordinating review required substantial revision of anatomy, hair/beard continuity and ceramic response before technical acceptance work.
findings: Faces too elongated and generic; eyes too small and noses too long.
Sparse oval hair pieces over a smooth cap do not read as curls or sculpted hair.
Hemingway beard has abrupt plate edges and pinched mouth geometry.
Tolstoy beard is a floating thin shield with a large profile gap and pasted oval locks.
Seat meets the head weakly; glaze reads overly yellow and plastic in current lighting.

iterations.summary: Full image coverage split between reviewers. Integrated Pushkin curls and removal of Tolstoy rear-neck beard texture improved continuity; generic sculptural faces/materials and limited fine detail remain. This is a pre-resize intermediate source, not the final current outcome.
findings: Separate rounded curl beads and sideburn chains were replaced by a visually connected hair surface; no visible join gaps were observed in profile/back.
Tolstoy rear-neck beard texture was removed; the elongated lower rear head volume and cap-like rear hair boundary remain visible.
High and Economy retain all three overall silhouettes and their broad distinguishing hair/beard types; no major element disappears.
Facial anatomy remains generic and smooth; pale almond eye inserts with sharp circular irises give a doll-like gaze.
Economy softens lip, moustache, nose and groove separation; Tolstoy parallel beard channels also resemble drapery in High.
Regular curl relief, stylized pedestal joins and warm/violet light response remain limitations. Portrait likeness and maximum realism are not accepted.

iterations.summary: Same resized runtime as art-a9; only the inspection camera changed to include the whole assembly. All fifteen frames reviewed: root three High three-quarter views and network_capabilities twelve remaining views.
findings: The enlarged lower plate reads as a broad dish with a rounded rim and a smooth transition into the central neck; the entire outline is visible in the inspected views.
Heads and details retain their proportions and major elements at High and Economy. No visible gap at the head-to-neck join or newly introduced size-related intersection was observed.
Tolstoy beard remains in front of the supporting neck and does not visibly cut through the plate.
Generic smooth faces, doll-like eyes, regular curl relief, drapery-like beard grooves and warm/violet lighting remain limitations; likeness and realistic ceramic material are not accepted.
